# Browser Markdown assets

These pinned, locally served browser bundles have no runtime CDN dependency.
They are copied unchanged from their npm release archives:

| File | Package | Version | License | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `markdown-it.umd.min.js` | `markdown-it` | 15.0.3 | MIT | `391f2aa638e75e6c7859d0a5c5650ef0956722a45998f17e05b83bc655778e1e` |
| `purify.min.js` | `dompurify` | 3.4.17 | Apache-2.0 | `cd37898f9782adf54820c413191b5691803f0f137c799d6edcfd38523b4c2c31` |

The associated license texts are included in this directory. When updating a
bundle, update its version and checksum here and rerun the frontend checks.
